description: USE WHEN you need the SHAPE of a research field rather than a list of its members: phase / status / study-type mix, sponsor concentration, enrollment scale, the completed-but-unreported results gap, momentum over 30/90/365 days, and a real diff against a stored earlier snapshot. READ `fieldCompleteness` BEFORE QUOTING ANY DISTRIBUTION — if phase is recorded for a quarter of a registry's records, the phase mix describes that quarter, not the field. `evidenceGap` reports the reporting failure per registry and deliberately refuses to publish a combined figure when the registries' results flags are not comparable. NEXT: search_world_trials to inspect the trials behind a bucket, get_trial_coverage to check how much of the population is duplicate registrations.

condition.description: Exact registry condition term. Prefer q unless you know the exact string.

country.description: Recruiting/site country: full English name or ISO code (US, USA, UK, DE, ...).

crossRegistry.description: true = only trials registered in more than one registry.

intervention.description: Free-text intervention match: the way to separate MODALITIES within one disease.

phase.description: Comma-separated phases: 1-4, I-IV, early_phase1, or 1/2. Phase is missing for much of the corpus.

q.description: Free-text condition/intervention query, e.g. "type 1 diabetes islet". Tokens are ANDed.

registry.description: clinicaltrials_gov | isrctn. OMIT for full-index scope, restricting to one registry makes the answer single-registry evidence.

resultsAvailable.description: Restrict to trials with/without posted results.

status.description: recruiting | active_not_recruiting | not_yet_recruiting | completed | halted | terminated | withdrawn | not_authorised | unknown, or "active" for any open status (recruiting + active_not_recruiting + not_yet_recruiting). Case-insensitive; unknown values return 400.

topic.description: Cure Protocol topic id (get_trial_stats lists them).

updatedSince.description: ISO date: only records updated on/after this date.

name: get_trial_landscape
